tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Find prepaid travel eSIM data plans by two-letter ISO destination code. Prices are USD. Country-only plans are preferred; regional bundles are a fallback. No order or payment is created.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Read current public details for a plan ID returned by search_plans. Unavailable or withdrawn plans return an error.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Get a link for the customer to review and buy one currently available eSIM on OffWeGoSIM. This only returns a URL. It does not reserve a price, create an order, charge a card or issue an eSIM.
